catalog.nvfp4Search: Blackwell GPU min hakilijagabɔlen bɛrɛbɛrɛ bɛ sɔrɔ, o bɛ sɔrɔ. NVFP4 suguyaw ka fisa ni fɛn dilanni ni motɛri bɛ u dɛmɛ. Native FLUX.2 Klein 4B Comfy loading bɛ sɔrɔ sigida sɔrɔyɔrɔw la; CUDA PyTorch, danfara minnu bɛ se ka sugandi, taamaɲɔgɔnw modɛliw ani hakilijagabɔ fu lajɛ sani i ka telesarse. Hardware detection tɛ baarakɛcogo labɛnna tiɲɛ walima ka teliya garanti.
catalog.nvfp4Prefer: NVFP4 bɛ ladilikan di nin GPU ni FLUX.2 Klein 4B denbaya ma. Native loading bɛ Comfy labɛncogo dɛmɛnen de wajibiya, CUDA PyTorch ani dependencies optionnels. Ja modeli, Qwen3 encoder ani VAE sugandi danfara la Dabɔcogo la. Boli waati, farali dafalen ani hakilijagabɔ fu mago bɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛli la hali bi.
catalog.nvfp4Check: NVFP4 kɔlɔsira: GPU seko, hakilijagabɔ hɔrɔnyalen, girinya labɛncogo walima fɛn dilanni dɛmɛ ma dafa. CUDA motɛri lajɛ sani i ka nin suguya in sugandi. O cogoya dɔrɔn tɛ bɛnkan Sìgi.
catalog.nvfp4Unsupported: Native NVFP4 tɛ ladilikan ye ni GPU kɔlɔsilen ye walima sisan hɔrɔnyalen VRAM. Aw ye GGUF jatebɔ min bɛ bɛn ɲɔgɔn ma walima bɛnkan masin jateminɛ. O sira tɛ FP4 teliya nafama di.
catalog.quantQualityAdvice: Novera GGUF bilasirali sɛbɛnw, ja ani wideyow yɔrɔw kan: Q6_K walima ka tɛmɛ o kan, o ye an ka daminɛyɔrɔ sugandilen ye n’an bɛ kantigiya bila jɔyɔrɔ fɔlɔ la Q4_K_M bɛ balansi don jogo ni hakilijagabɔ la. Olu ye laadilikanw ye, u tɛ diɲɛ bɛɛ ka tiɲɛni dantigɛli ye. Jateminɛw bɛ bɔ misali ni baara la. NVFP4 ani jatebɔ fɛɛrɛ wɛrɛw mago bɛ u yɛrɛ ka bɛnkan ni jogoɲini na.
